verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents querying post-send statistics for individual emails or sets of emails through the Marketing Emails API, dashboards that show campaign performance data in one place, and multi-touch attribution for conversions. The pack never names the specific metrics (opens, clicks, unsubscribes), per-workflow-step reporting, or time-series trending. missing for 10: explicit open/click/unsubscribe metric documentation, per-automation-step analytics, over-time trend reporting, conversion metrics tied per campaign, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can read opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and conversions per campaign and per automation step, over time

citations.quote: You can also query details about the post-send statistics of a specific email or set of emails.
Your HubSpot account includes flexible, customizable dashboards that allow you to see campaign performance data in one place and easily share reports with stakeholders.
Drive revenue with multi-touch attribution and customer journey analytics that show what's actually working.
